subject: SOC 2 attestation: log custody plan, archival policy & capacity onramp

Subject: SOC 2 re-attestation: log custody & evidence cadence

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for walking us through the platform last week. Our internal audit is kicking off next month and we need to align on two items for our renewal: 1) definitive custody of audit logs during the attestation window (90 days prior plus sampling) and 2) how Redwood will provide packaged evidence for the SOC 2 examiners (file format, indexes, and retention proof).

High level ask: can you provide a short runbook and a sample evidence bundle we can hand to our auditors? Also include any options for increasing log retention or a short-term burst if needed (we may want to run a two-week deep-retention snapshot).

Appreciate a response by EOD Wednesday so we can update the audit plan.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Yao
Head of IT Compliance, Novus Analytics

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the clear asks. We can deliver a compact evidence bundle and a custody statement that maps every audit artifact back to the custody event (hosted, dedicated, or archived). I’ll put together a short runbook + sample bundle by Wednesday. A few clarifying points so I scope correctly:

- What timeframe do you expect examiners to request? (standard is 90 days pre-attestation; confirm if you want 180d).
- Do you prefer raw log exports (gz/json) or pre-indexed XLS for your auditors? We can provide both but it changes packaging time.
- For short-term deep-retention: are you asking for a configured retention policy increase or an ad-hoc export snapshot?

Looping in Rishi and Laura for retention/capacity details.

Thanks,

Date: Tue, 30 Apr 2029 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: SOC 2 re-attestation: log custody & evidence cadence

Kimberly / team —

Draft answers below for the runbook scope:

1) Timeframe: default attestation window we use is 90 days. If Novus needs 180 days we can support it but it becomes an archival policy change and may require a temporary seat/top-up for increased storage and retrieval IO.

2) Formats: we can produce both raw gzipped JSON logs and an auditor-friendly index spreadsheet (.xlsx) that cross-references file hashes, start/end timestamps, and custody tokens. For speed, deliver raw logs + an autogenerated index.

3) Deep retention snapshot: we can do an ad-hoc snapshot on Dedicated or Hosted with a one-time export to a temporary S3 bucket (customer-controlled) and provide transfer verification (SHA256 manifests). Burst/onramp pricing: 250GB-2TB tiers; estimate attached in the capacity sheet.

I attached a preliminary mapping: log-retention-mapping-2029-04.pdf and a sample evidence index template (novus-soc2-evidence-index-v2.xlsx).

If Novus confirms timeline/format, we’ll finalize the runbook and a statement of custody doc.

-Rishi
Senior Manager, Reliability & Platform Ops | Redwood Inference

Sarah
